_comment: Per-scenario throughput floors for Aquilia, in requests/second.
_rationale: A benchmark that only reports numbers cannot catch a regression; someone has to
notice the number moved. These floors make CI do the noticing.
Each floor is set below the measured value with headroom for run-to-run noise on
a shared runner, so a failure means a real regression rather than a slow morning.
The margin is deliberately generous: a gate that cries wolf gets disabled, and a
Raise a floor when a change legitimately improves throughput -- that is what locks
the win in. Lowering one requires justification in the commit message.
_measured_on: darwin arm64, Python 3.11, single uvicorn worker, _core+_dataengine+_json present
